title: The Unsaid Glasshouse
author: Sable Quintana
blurb: Sable Thornbury, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
